title: Unused Imports and Modules
damaged_code:
```rust
use std::collections::HashSet; // imported but never used
fn process_vec() {}
```
pattern: Importing modules, traits, or structs that are never referenced or utilized in the current file.
why_bad: Clutters the top of the file, increases compiling dependencies, and confuses readers regarding what external libraries are actually relied on.
detection: Import statements (`use` declarations) that are completely unreferenced in the downstream code.
counterexample: Importing traits purely for their blanket implementations or macro registrations (e.g., in some serialization crates).
source: Robert C. Martin, *Clean Code* (2008), Chapter 17 ("Smells and Heuristics - G9: Dead Code"), p. 168.
